作成メニューや Ontology の画面に、生成 AI が Ontology の: The create menu or the ontology screen may offer an entry point where generative AI helps build the ontology, or another way to start. 別の入口が見えても Core では使わない: Another entry point may appear; Core does not use it
公式ドキュメントでは、スキーマ側の変更（Property・型・関係の追加や削除）: The official documentation explains that schema-side changes (adding or removing properties, types or relationships) flow downstream automatically, whereas a change to the upstream source data alone is invisible to the graph, so stale data can be shown until you refresh the graph model by hand. To refresh it, open the graph model that belongs to the ontology in the workspace item list and choose [Refresh now] under [Schedule]. Do not run it after every small change; batch them and run it once. Each refresh re-ingests everything, which shows up in capacity consumption.
ソース側だけが変わったときは手動で更新する: Refresh by hand when only the source changed
定義は正しいのに古い値のまま見える: The definition is right but the values shown are stale
上流のソースだけが更新され、グラフモデルがそれを知らない: Only the upstream source changed, and the graph model does not know
グラフモデルの［Schedule］→［Refresh now］で手動更新してから: Refresh the graph model by hand with [Schedule] -> [Refresh now], then check again
manifest が正本であるという前提は、preview と apply のあ: The manifest stays canonical between preview and apply. Between running preview and running apply, do not let any other authoring tool rewrite the same ontology. If the definition moves in between, the apply-time recheck either stops on a difference or the registered count no longer matches the contracted 98 objects. If you are working with someone else, ask them to stop editing until apply has finished.
preview と apply のあいだは同時編集しない: Do not edit concurrently between preview and apply
ここで構成する Fabric Data Agent は、既存のソースへ問い合わせ: The Fabric Data Agent configured here is the consuming side: it queries existing sources and answers. It is not an authoring assistant that rewrites the ontology definition. No amount of configuration here changes an entity, a relationship or a property. For the idea of letting generative AI help with authoring, appendix D.6 records the evaluation angle only, and Core does not do it.
Data Agent は消費側であって編集側ではない: The Data Agent consumes; it does not author
ワークショップの範囲ではここまでで完了です。同じ構成を実際の業務データで公開する: That is as far as the workshop goes. Publishing the same setup against real business data also means checking the platform prerequisites: permissions, retention, where processing happens, customer-managed keys and consumption. Appendix C.6 collects them as ten items.
ソースを更新したのに Instances が古いまま、または 0 件のまま: The source was updated but Instances are stale, or still zero
上流のソースだけが変わり、グラフモデルが再取り込みされていない。: Only the upstream source changed, so the graph model has not re-ingested.
グラフモデルの［Schedule］→［Refresh now］で手動更新する。変: Refresh the graph model by hand with [Schedule] -> [Refresh now]. Batch changes and run it once.
preview では差分 0 だったのに apply で停止する: Preview showed no differences but apply stops
preview と apply のあいだに、別の編集手段から Ontology: Another authoring tool rewrote the ontology between preview and apply.
編集を止めてから preview をやり直す。manifest が正本であり、合: Stop the edits and rerun preview. The manifest is canonical; the ontology is what has to match.

機能単位のコンプライアンス適合は主張しない。容量のリージョンとテナント設定の現在: Do not claim compliance per feature. Record the current capacity region and tenant settings before publishing.
